title: Botol Melati
subject: A rig worker's wife in Balikpapan soaks jasmine from the back fence in oil before every 28-day rotation and refills the small bottle in his jacket pocket so his collar smells of home
caption: Indonesian 1970s pop cengeng ballad. A lush string section plays long legato lines, a mellow electric piano carries the chords, a nylon-string guitar plays slow arpeggios, a soft bass guitar and brushed drums keep a gentle slow 4/4 pulse. Warm tape sound, gentle room reverb, unhurried and spacious. A female lead sings in a sincere mid-range with soft vibrato on long notes. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 70 BPM, F major. Tender, wistful mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no distorted guitar, no modern synth pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - electric piano, strings]

[Verse 1]
Tiap tanggal berangkat kupetik melati
Dari pagar belakang rumah kita
Kurendam dalam minyak semalam
Kuisi botol kecil di saku jaketmu

[Pre-Chorus]
Dua puluh delapan hari di tengah laut
Hidungmu ingat jalan pulang

[Chorus]
Teteskan satu di kerah bajumu
Saat angin laut terlalu asin
Itu aku, itu rumah, itu halaman
Yang menunggumu pulang

[Verse 2]
Kau kirim pesan lewat radio kapal
Botol sudah kosong, tinggal baunya
Kupetik lagi, melati tak pernah habis
Seperti aku yang tak pandai pergi

[Chorus]
Teteskan satu di kerah bajumu
Kalau botolnya kosong, ciumlah tutupnya
Itu aku, itu rumah, itu halaman
Yang menunggumu pulang

[Outro - strings, nylon guitar]
Hitung hari, melati mekar lagi
Hitung hari, kau pulang lagi
